title: 提示语言影响大语言模型的诊断推理与准确性
summary: 研究评估了五种LLM在英语和法语临床场景下的诊断推理与准确性，发现除o3外，其他模型在英语中表现更优，提示语言是影响LLM临床性能的关键因素。
summary_en: Evaluating five LLMs on clinical vignettes in English and French, the study finds that prompting language significantly impacts diagnostic reasoning and accuracy, with most models performing better in English except o3.
